## Yendo - Senior Backend Engineer

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/yendo/25480cd6-cf73-4898-826c-3aae4cfa2288)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Backend Engineer at Yendo focusing on backend and full stack solutions to enhance financial access for users. Collaborating within a small team to raise the bar in engineering practices and customer experience.
Senior Backend Engineer developing financial solutions at Yendo
- Salary: $170,000 - $220,000 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Java, Postgres, Python, Redis, Ruby, TypeScript, Go
- Desire to work collaboratively. Engineers participate in the product development cycle from start to finish.
- Help with raising the bar! We strive to improve our customer experience, our hiring standards, and our engineering practices.
- Resiliency. We are not a “me too” product. This requires experimentation and grit to find solutions for our customers’ problems.
- 5+ years of experience with backend or full stack solutions (e.g., Go (*Preferred)*, TypeScript, Java, Python, or Ruby)
- Prefer experience with Postgres, Redis, and AWS, but not required.
- Enjoy thinking about systems — their life cycles, edge cases, interactions, and failure modes.
- Self-starter and able to work independently.
- Experience in fintech, payments, processing, card networks, banking, or early stage startup is helpful, but not required.
- Passionate about financial inclusion and mobility.

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer at Yendo focusing on backend and full stack solutions to enhance financial access for users. Collaborating within a small team to raise the bar in engineering practices and customer experience.
Senior Backend Engineer developing financial solutions at Yendo
Role description:
• Desire to work collaboratively. Engineers participate in the product development cycle from start to finish.
• Help with raising the bar! We strive to improve our customer experience, our hiring standards, and our engineering practices.
• Resiliency. We are not a “me too” product. This requires experimentation and grit to find solutions for our customers’ problems.
Role requirements:
• 5+ years of experience with backend or full stack solutions (e.g., Go (*Preferred)*, TypeScript, Java, Python, or Ruby)
• Prefer experience with Postgres, Redis, and AWS, but not required.
• Enjoy thinking about systems — their life cycles, edge cases, interactions, and failure modes.
• Self-starter and able to work independently.
• Experience in fintech, payments, processing, card networks, banking, or early stage startup is helpful, but not required.
• Passionate about financial inclusion and mobility.
Benefits:
• Competitive Compensation
• Equity
• Insurance
• 401K
• Unlimited PTO
Tech stack:
AWS, Java, Postgres, Python, Redis, Ruby, TypeScript, Go
